toolsPreview.name: model_finder

toolsPreview.name: track_ui_event
toolsPreview.description: Internal telemetry for the wizard UI. Records one anonymous event server-side (no personal data, no free-form text). The AI must NOT call this tool proactively; it is only invoked by the UI.
